sourceOfTruth.behavior: Each component contract in this registry owns runtime behavior, accessibility, layout, and state for every framework that implements it. Flutter implementations in packages/catch_ui/lib/src and the remaining app-coupled lib/core/widgets are the reference implementation; @catch/web-ui implements the same contracts for React.
sourceOfTruth.tokens: design/tokens/catch.tokens.json owns primitive token values; generated Dart/CSS and Figma variables mirror it.
sourceOfTruth.designTools: Figma and Claude Design may compose these contracts, but they do not own production widget implementation.
sourceOfTruth.handoff: Design handoffs should name contract ids and props. Arbitrary JSX/CSS is proposal material until mapped to these contracts.

rules: The owning product surface keeps domain value, validation, and async state.
The field owns row geometry, disclosure chrome, adornment placement, and status presentation.
Explicit text editors keep outlined Cancel and put the character count at the leading side of the commit row; errors reuse the caption and may wrap without clipping.
Text value contracts own requiredness and Optional labels; an emptied optional draft commits through Clear using its domain adapter, with hints sharing value typography.
New modes or semantic slots require the Flutter API, component contract, Widgetbook coverage, tests, and generated facade inventory to change together.
The section owns grouping, dividers, contained chrome, header composition, and field-row focus or error treatment.
Contained field-row titles, counts, and trailing actions sit outside the row-group outline; generic contained content-card titles remain inside their surface.
Product surfaces keep route layout and domain state outside the section contract.
Use field sections for data entry and management surfaces, never as a generic storytelling container.

Dependent fields attach to their controlling field through a tint inside one rounded perimeter. Applicability is feature-owned; no nested outlines, automatic modal depth, or dividers that imply peers.

props.notes: Optional native completion override for direct inputs, invoked before onSubmitted. Omit to retain Flutter keyboard-action focus handling; chat supplies a callback that keeps the editor focused after Send.

props.name: fontFeatures
props.notes: Native text font features appended to the existing theme style for standalone entry and unit text, including tabularFigures for aligned numeric data.

props.name: status
props.notes: Canonical save state for trailing feedback, disclosure interaction lock, commit actions and accessibility announcements. Saving disables choices, option cards and steppers. A visible commit bar owns the sole progress indicator; otherwise the trailing lane owns it. Saved remains a trailing success tick. Direct input edit permissions remain caller-owned.

props.name: emptyValueText
props.notes: Optional override for root-localized 'Add {field}' copy. It appears only while an editable row is empty and inactive; it does not replace the native input or its focused hint.

props.name: inputHint

props.name: badgeLabel

props.name: itemTitleBuilder

props.name: itemDescriptionBuilder

props.name: states

props.name: secondaryAction

Explicit-save compatibility order is editor, supporting metadata, feedback, secondary action, then Cancel and Done. Validation/helper/counter support is a root sibling after disclosure controls and the commit bar, matching the React handoff. Field-caption color is resolved once at the root: actual error uses danger, active focus or open disclosure uses semantic ink, and inactive state uses the configured tone or ink3. Optional suffix copy remains ink3. Focus never changes label size, weight, baseline, or position.

Press feedback begins on header pointer down; disclosure ownership transfers once on pointer up. The full-row disclosure drawer is a sibling below that header, so nested chips, steppers, and commit buttons cannot trigger header press tint and retain complete hit/focus geometry. Ordinary inputs retain Flutter's shared EditableText tap group for affiliated actions and place the native cursor during the first gesture. A closed explicit-save input transfers native focus when its drawer reveal completes so keyboard viewport relayout cannot compete with disclosure motion; an editor built already open focuses immediately, and a direct input tap during reveal may still focus intentionally. reducedMotion.policy: Render the same stable resting state without requiring animation to understand or complete the interaction.

notes: Callers own metric identity, formatted values and all visible copy, including partial and missing status labels.

components.name: CatchViewport
components.summary: One local viewport owner with named size-class, explicit-width, sliver geometry, readable sliver lane and bounded-scene recipes.

props.name: breakpoint
props.notes: Required by atWidth; compares actual local width using below versus at-or-above semantics.

props.name: sliverBuilder
props.notes: Required by sliver; returns a sliver from local cross-axis geometry.

props.name: maxWidth
props.notes: Required by scene; caps the local or MediaQuery fallback width.

props.name: builder
props.notes: Required by scene; receives bounded width/height and inherited media padding.

props.name: child
props.notes: Required sliver content for sliverLane; stays direct below the width cap.

props.name: maxExtent
props.notes: Positive local cross-axis width cap for sliverLane; wide lanes are centered without gutters.

members.summary: Immutable local width and Material size class delivered by the sliver viewport.
Immutable bounded scene width, height and inherited safe-area padding.

largeText.policy: Pass inherited text scaling through unchanged; caller-owned compact, medium and expanded layouts retain their text and actions at scale 2.0.

reducedMotion.policy: Render the same stable resting state without requiring animation to understand or complete the interaction.

notes: The default applies CatchWindowSize thresholds to available local width, with medium-to-compact and expanded-to-medium-to-compact fallbacks.
atWidth selects below versus at-or-above a caller-owned threshold; feature ComponentBreakpoints stay in the app.
sliver supplies its cross-axis extent and size class without reading global window metrics.
scene caps width, takes bounded local height and preserves inherited media padding; only unbounded axes fall back to MediaQuery size.
Master/detail viewport owns two-pane composition, index width and a divider. This viewport instead measures local geometry for caller-owned content; it owns no product selection or navigation.

sliverLane applies the same local-width ownership to sliver content: direct at or below maxExtent, centered with equal flexible sides above it. The compact and width-capped states retain their existing meaning; page-body padding and scroll ownership remain with PageBody and its screen owner.

verification.reason: Canonical states are exercised through the generated Widgetbook contract.
